move: web and app screens slide into a 3D staircase, scroll, slide out
how: Six mockups alternating 520x350 browser windows and 210x440 phones sit in a wrapper set to rotateY -18 / rotateX 8. Each fromTo's from x +420, y -60, rotateY -30, opacity 0 to its stair pose (x -400+190i, y -90+34i, z -100i) with 1.0s expo.out, staggered 0.28s from 1.5% of the 10s duration. A title fades up at 12%. From 15% the wrapper turns rotateY -18->-8 and slides x 40->-40 over 6s sine.inOut while each body scrolls y -120 then back with power3.inOut in a 0.15s wave (32-72%). At 85% screens slide to x -500 with rotateY 20 and fade (expo.in, 0.14s stagger); the title drops and fades.
adapt: Replace the items array (kind web/app, hero gradient, title, dark flag), the title text and the background gradients; pose() controls spacing. Keep the 1.0s expo.out entries with 0.28s stagger and the 6s sine pan.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .cas with the mixed screens from shot.items and applies the initial wrapper gsap.set; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with entries at (0.015 + i*0.028)*D, pan at 0.15D, scrolls at 0.32D/0.58D and exit at 0.85D. The title from() should be fromTo with immediateRender:false; el needs perspective:2200px.
caveats: catalog lists 18s but the file renders 10s
loop does not close: screens slide out left
